prompt: A haunted library: return the cursed books to their shelves

intent.setting: A decaying, gothic library at night with flickering gaslight, towering dust-cloaked shelves in the main reading room, a circular atrium, a restricted manuscript vault, a forbidden-works wing and a ruined archive annex
intent.role: A night archivist sent to uncursed the collection
intent.goal: Find every cursed, glowing book, read its wisp of ink-light, and return each one to the marked slot on its original shelf before the final bell tolls
intent.fail: The wailing bells toll out the hour and the haunted stacks slam shut, sealing the archivist inside
intent.mood: Eerie, hushed, anxious dread over a beautiful old space
intent.headline: Cursed books must be matched to marked shelf slots across five wing rooms
